verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex markets time tracking as a built-in add-on that works with payroll "without switching systems, moving data." It ties time tracking to payroll accuracy and offers fixes for missing punches, which implies punched hours reach the payroll run. However, nothing describes hourly entries syncing into payroll in detail, and overtime is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of hourly time entries flowing into the payroll run, overtime calculation and transfer to payroll, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have hourly time entries and overtime flow directly into the payroll run

citations.quote: Add benefits, time tracking, or HR tools when you need them, without switching systems, moving data, or retraining your team.
Track time and maximize payroll accuracy.
AI-suggested Modifications and employee self-service speed up fixes for missing punches.
